answer: Each identity runs a ridge vine row with a 70-credit bond and 50 reserve. Each vine sale carries a kernel-signed warranty: if stock fails, the buyer claims, an auditor checks the delivery record on the ridge board, valid claims draw on the reserve; no record, or a mismatched kernel key, burns bond and reserve. Row fees rise: first 20, kth 20+4(k-1), 1000th 4016; 1000 fakes pay 2,018,000 plus 120,000 held, one row per key, no pooling. A phantom-stock ring fails: its stock was never grown, so a claim finds no record. An honest grower pays 20 once and recovers both after a clean epoch.
